brief:
A poll of U.S. university students found that 74 percent acknowledge Israeli occupation forces are committing genocide against the Palestinian people, according to Shehab Wire. The survey was conducted by the Maurice and Marlyn Cohen Center.

The finding reflects growing awareness among American college campuses regarding allegations of mass atrocities in Gaza. Student opinion on the Israeli-Palestinian conflict has become increasingly prominent on university campuses across the country in recent months.
